_doc: AUTHORITATIVE reference for design-system VALUES (owner directive 2026-08-07: the SSOT states the values; use them; measure only the unstated; stated wins on conflict). `colors` is the app's reconciled M3 ColorScheme on origin/main (core/designsystem/.../Color.kt): #348 aligned it to the rev5 SSOT README.md §Tokens for every role README lists (pinned by RevFiveColorTokenTest), and it carries the M3-standard value for the rest. `readmeStated` names the README-listed subset — the authoritative rev5 values. This is the valid-token reference for the conformance gate: an in-scope language-screen colour must equal the value of the M3 role its element uses (ads #139 are out of scope). specs/*.json is the MEASURED layer, used only for the UNSTATED (per-element positions; font roles outside the 4-size scale). reconcile.mjs reports measured-vs-this divergence.

colors._source: core/designsystem/.../Color.kt @ origin/main (post-#348). Keys are androidx.compose.material3.ColorScheme role names.

readmeStated._doc: The roles README.md §Tokens (:52-54) explicitly lists — the authoritative rev5 values #348 pinned into `colors`. README's informal names map to M3 roles: light 'container #e9eef6' -> surfaceContainerHigh (verified: LightSurfaceContainerHigh=#e9eef6, LightSurfaceContainer=#efeded — the co-verify #350 BLOCK); light 'variant #444746' -> onSurfaceVariant; dark 'container #1e1f20'/'high #2d2f31' -> surfaceContainer/surfaceContainerHigh. Roles NOT here (tertiary*, secondary*, the rest of the ladder) are M3-standard, not README-listed — valid tokens, but the README does not pin their value.

extensions._doc: App design-system tokens outside the M3 ColorScheme. LocalMeterFillColor (core/designsystem/.../MeterColors.kt) — the storage-bar used segment; light #c4d7f5 / dark #0842a0 (== dark primaryContainer). Landed #348. Not in README §Tokens (the owner's 'measure the unstated' case, measured from the drawings).

type._note: Sizes are stated; weights are NOT stated in README §Tokens -> weight is unstated (measure it, or take the M3 default for the role: e.g. titleLarge=Regular/400). Text roles OUTSIDE these 4 (detail-pane headline/display, metric numbers) are unstated -> measured. Material-Symbols icon glyphs are NOT type-scale text and are excluded from the font check (see reconcile.mjs / the `ic` flag in specs).
